The Indian Army will conduct a recruitment rally for enrolment of Agniveers from all 33 districts of Telangana at the GMC Balayogi Athletic Stadium in Gachibowli from November 13 to 24.
The rally will screen candidates for four categories: Agniveer General Duty, Agniveer Technical, Agniveer Tradesman (10th pass) and Agniveer Tradesman (8th pass). Candidates who have received admit cards for the rally must report to the venue with all required documents in original, as specified in the recruitment notification for the 2027 recruiting year.
The Army has cautioned candidates against touts and fraudsters promising selection or enrolment in exchange for money. It said the recruitment process is fully automated, fair and transparent, and that agents or intermediaries have no role in the selection process.
Candidates can visit www.joinindianarmy.nic.in for recruitment-related information. They can also contact the Army Recruiting Office, Secunderabad, at 040-27740059 for clarifications.
